newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Hi-Bred to expand DuPont unit pact.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Hi-Bred to expand DuPont unit pact.

text.p: Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc and DuPont Co's DuPont Agricultural Products units said Wednesday they plan to expand a research agreement that will permit Pioneer to test and potentially market seed capable of producing DuPont Optimum High Oil Corn.
The planned agreement could result in a significant increase in future production of the added-value grain, the companies said.

Optimum High Oil Corn, which has an oil content as high as 8.5 percent, compared with four percent or less in typical dent corn varieties, was harvested from about 350,000 acres in 1996, DuPont Quality Grains said. Nearly one million acres are expected to be planted in 1997, the company said.
